description: A tested reference reads the projected original span. t reads the synthetic T, which projects to the empty span, so t="ta" fails and c is no reading. The check passes with the chosen reading alone. Compare reparse-terminal-sound-test (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [+T="ta"]
%rule b A [+T="ta"] [+U]
%rule c A t="ta"
%rule t T
